newsitem.title: USA: Netanyahu to visit U.S. this week.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu to visit U.S. this week.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will arrive in Washington on Wednesday ahead of meetings with President Bill Clinton and other key U.S. officials, the Israeli embassy said on Monday.
The embassy said Netanyahu would meet Clinton on Thursday afternoon following an early-morning meeting with Secretary of State Madeleine Albright.
He would also hold talks with Defence Secretary William Cohen and Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin before departing Washington, the embassy said.

A spokeswoman for the White House National Security Council said the exact time of Clinton's meeting with Netanyahu had not been determined since Clinton would be attending the funeral of Ambassador to France Pamela Harriman in the morning.
